nodes.text: Angie looks around and spots a very tall hotel nearby.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: If I'm going to find him, I'm going to have to look higher. Much higher.
Angie tries to cut through the crowd to the hotel, but people are jostling her from all sides!
Moving is nearly impossible!
Angie looks around desperately for another way through. She sees a small park and rushes toward it.
In the park, Angie finds a huge ice skating rink!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The most direct route to the hotel is through that rink...
Angie runs onto the ice!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Whoa! This is more slippery than I thought it'd be!

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Run on the ice rink!

nodes.text: Angie treads quickly and carefully across the ice, dodging ice skaters and rough patches.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: This is much quicker than wading through the crowds!
Eventually, she makes it the other side.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I did it!
Back on asphalt, she starts running towards the hotel.
Angie slips!
She falls backwards, taking a skating couple out with her. They fall into a huge pile.
A group of little kids holding hands sees them, but can't dodge in time. They crash into Angie and the other skaters!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm stuck at the bottom! I can't move!
Angie tries to free herself, but manages to end up in a great tangle with the skaters!
A precious ten minutes later...
Angie frees herself.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I don't have much time to find $Scott... That really tripped me up.
She slides carefully off the ice until she reaches a concrete path. She starts sprinting towards the hotel.
Angie rushes to the very top of the hotel and pushes the door out onto the rooftop.
Angie looks around and sees..

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: $Scott?
At the ledge, $Scott turns around.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Angie! I was looking all over for you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I was looking for you all over too! What happened?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You tried to lead me up the hill, but a group of tourists swept me a short ways down.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: When I turned around, you were gone!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Then I thought of coming up here to see if I could spot you...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: But I found you instead!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And right on time too! Look!
He points out from the rooftop. The rooftop boasts a great view of the Ball Drop and the fireworks.
A countdown from below sounds. $Scott takes Angie's hands, and they count down together.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `Happy New Year!`

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: `Happy New Year!`
They share a kiss on the rooftop.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: To this year...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: To next year...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: And to all the years to come!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I hope I get to spend them with you.
$Scott and Angie share a special New Year's kiss amidst the colorful sprays of fireworks in the distance.
Congratulations! You helped Angie find $Scott just in time!
Happy New Year from Surviving High School!
Angie looks around and sees...
Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh... Somehow, I thought he'd be here.
She rushes to the ledge and looks out, hoping to see his face.
Around her, people start counting down...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: No... I was hoping to find $Scott, so we could be together when...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Happy New Year!`

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: `Happy New Year!`

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Happy new year to you, $Scott... Wherever you are...
Oh no! Angie and $Scott are separated at midnight? That's a horrible way to ring in the New Year!
Try again and see if you can get them together this time!
Angie hops onto the nearest park bench and scans the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Shoot! I'm too close to everyone! All I can see are hats and heads!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'll never find $Scott this way!
Angie gets to the top of the hill and looks over the crowd.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Perfect! I can see everyone in the vicinity!
She slowly examines each face but doesn't see $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Doesn't look like he's even here... I don't know where I'm supposed to look next...
In the area around the square, Angie spots a park bench to one side and a hill on the other.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I should...

options.label: Get to the top of the hill.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, there's a good a spot to look as any.
Angie walks back to the restaurant.
She approaches a waitress.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me... I'm looking for my boyfriend. I lost him in the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He's approximately six inches taller than me, he's got great eyes, and he looks very Vice Presidential.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: I know who you're talking about.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You do?

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Someone stopped by just a minute ago asking about you.

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: He went back to Centerscore Square though.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Can you tell me where he might be headed?

nodes.speaker: Waitress
nodes.text: Afraid not. But if you keep thinking like him, I'm sure you'll find him eventually.
Angie walks back to the square.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: There must be some other way to find him... Maybe I can see him in the crowd if I get high enough.
Angie elbows to the middle of the square where a statue of the founding fathers is.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Doesn't look like he's here...
Angie runs into someone and is knocked to the ground!
She hits her elbow on the hard concrete.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Ow!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I got a bruise, `and` $Scott's not here.
nodes.text_bbcode: I got a bruise, [color=#3b78e2][i]and[/i][/color] $Scott's not here.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: There must be some other way to find him... Maybe I can see him in the crowd if I get high enough.
Happy Holidays! Welcome to a special premium mini-episode of Surviving High School!
You'll be playing as Angie. Can you help her find $Scott in time for New Year's?
Find out now!
It's December 31, and $Scott and Angie are out, celebrating New Year's together.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh, $Scott, thank you for the wonderful dinner.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I didn't even know there was an entire restaurant devoted to people with organizational skills.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: The way the plates were served perfectly centered on the place mat, and the way the vegetables were in a precise circle around the meat...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The second I saw the waiters use rulers to arrange food I knew it was the place for you.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It was magical!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, I had to make up for last year when I was being mopey over Hector's party.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's right! I can't believe that was a year ago.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: It's been a good year...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, except for that part where Justin blackmailed you into breaking up with me so he could be President.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: `That` wasn't good.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: But here we are now, together. And Justin is President and one of my good friends.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, about that...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: You're not still mad at him, are you? He's done some pretty great things as President. You two could actually get along.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Yeah, right. I'll be sure to make `that` one of my New Year's resolutions.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, right. I'll be sure to make [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] one of my New Year's resolutions.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: As long as it's far below giving your boyfriend a kiss every day.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Of course!
$Scott and Angie kiss.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: So where are we going now?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well, we have thirty minutes until the Ball Drop in Centerscore Square.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I thought we'd make our way there early, so that we can find a good spot...
They walk to the square where people have gathered for the New Year's Ball Drop.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Whoa, I'm glad we're here now. It's `really` packed.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa, I'm glad we're here now. It's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] packed.

nodes.text: They try to navigate through the thick crowd.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Where do you think we should stand?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I'm not sure... Maybe somewhere over near that hill?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Normally, I'd agree, but because of the buildings, our view of the Centerscore Ball might get blocked.
She lets go of $Scott's hand to get a better view of the land. She points in another direction.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: How about on those park benches over there?
$Scott doesn't reply.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...$Scott?
Angie looks back in $Scott's direction, but he's nowhere to be found!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh no! $Scott?! Where are you?
She walks around in a circle, calling his name. She gets bumped around in the crowd.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's no use... He probably can't hear me above everyone here anyway...
Angie pulls out her phone and calls $Scott's. It goes straight to his voicemail.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He must have turned it off or something.
Angie wanders back to where she lost $Scott.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: There's a smart way to find him. If I were $Scott, where would I go if we were separated?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I would go...

options.label: Back to the restaurant we ate at!
To the middle of the square!
